verdict.rationale: Airbyte offers Terraform provider for config-as-code, an API/CLI for programmatic control, and PyAirbyte for Python-based pipeline definitions, all of which support versioning connections in a repo. However, connectors/pipelines are still mostly built and configured via the Airbyte UI (Connector Builder, workspace settings), and there's no evidence of a fully code-native, git-native pipeline definition format (like YAML pipeline files checked into a repo as the primary authoring path) or CI/CD review workflow beyond Terraform state. missing for 10: a first-class code-first pipeline definition/authoring workflow (not just infra-as-code for connections), documented CI/CD or PR-review workflow for pipeline changes, and independent evidence of engineers actually versioning full pipelines as code in practice.
